01地缘政治与海事安全 · 2026年11月18日

ADNOC 油轮霍尔木兹海峡再遭袭击，1 名船员失踪、11 人受伤

ADNOC Tanker Hit for Second Time in Strait of Hormuz; One Crew Member Missing, 11 Injured

ADNOC Logistics & Services confirmed one of its tankers was attacked on the evening of 17 November while transiting the Strait of Hormuz, leaving one seafarer missing and 11 injured, with the rest of the crew evacuated and search and rescue under way. Maritime security firm Vanguard Tech identified the vessel as the Liberian-flagged product tanker Navig8 Messi, hit by an unknown projectile about 13 nautical miles north of Khasab, Oman. It was the vessel's second reported attack in the strait, after a UAV strike on 13 August. Seatrade counts 18 confirmed attacks on commercial vessels in and around the strait so far in November.

ADNOC 物流与服务公司确认，其一艘油轮 11 月 17 日晚在霍尔木兹海峡过境时遭袭，1 名船员失踪、11 人受伤，其余船员已撤离，搜救仍在进行。海事安全公司 Vanguard Tech 指认涉事船为利比里亚旗成品油轮 Navig8 Messi，在阿曼哈塞卜以北约 13 海里处被不明抛射物击中；该船今年 8 月 13 日已在同一海峡遭无人机袭击，这是第二次遇袭。Seatrade 统计，11 月以来霍尔木兹海峡及周边已确认的商船遇袭事件达 18 起。

02地缘政治与海事安全 · 2026年11月18日

美军扩大对伊朗海上封锁，船对船过驳接货船只也将被视为规避封锁

U.S. Targets Ship-to-Ship Transfers in Expanded Iran Maritime Blockade

U.S. Central Command said on 18 November that any ship receiving cargo via a ship-to-ship transfer from a vessel carrying cargo loaded at an Iranian port or coastline may be considered to be evading the blockade of Iranian ports, even if it has not entered Iranian ports itself. Such ships may be stopped, boarded, diverted, captured or directed to the Iranian port where the cargo originated, and non-compliance could face enforcement action including the use of force. The advisory added that the blockade will not impede neutral transit passage through the Strait of Hormuz to or from non-Iranian destinations. The blockade was first imposed on 13 April, lifted in June, and reimposed on 14 July after an agreement collapsed.

美国中央司令部 11 月 18 日发布通告称，任何从装载伊朗货物的船舶处通过船对船过驳接收货物的船舶，都可能被认定为规避对伊朗港口的封锁，即使其本身未进入伊朗港口或海岸线。此类船舶可能被拦截、登船、改航、扣押，或被勒令驶往货物原产的伊朗港口；不立即服从合法指令者可能面临包括使用武力在内的执法行动。通告同时称，封锁不妨碍中立船舶经霍尔木兹海峡往返非伊朗目的地的过境通行。该封锁最初于 4 月 13 日实施，6 月一度解除，7 月 14 日协议破裂后重新实施。

03地缘政治与海事安全 · 2026年11月18日

霍尔木兹海峡船运几近停摆，周末仅 5 艘船通过、周日为零

Just Five Ships Crossed Hormuz on Saturday as Tankers Stay Anchored

Shipping through the Strait of Hormuz slowed sharply over the weekend, with Kpler tracking data recording five cargo ships crossing on Saturday and none on Sunday, against 31 over the previous weekend, Reuters reported on 18 November. Daily traffic through the strait exceeded 130 ships before the war, while the strait handled about a fifth of the world's crude oil and LNG shipments. A 12 November Joint Maritime Information Center report estimated about 211 commercial vessels were stationary at major anchorages east of the strait, including Fujairah, Khor Fakkan, Sohar and Musandam.

路透社 11 月 18 日援引船舶跟踪数据报道，霍尔木兹海峡的船运在周末大幅放缓：周六仅 5 艘货船通过，周日没有记录到任何通过，而此前一个周末为 31 艘。冲突爆发前，该海峡每天通行船舶超过 130 艘，承担全球约五分之一的原油和液化天然气运输。联合海事信息中心 11 月 12 日的报告估计，约 211 艘商船停泊在海峡以东的主要锚地，包括富查伊拉、豪尔费坎、索哈尔和穆桑达姆。

04地缘政治与海事安全 · 2026年11月18日

刻赤大桥坍塌威胁亚速海粮食贸易

Kerch Bridge Collapse Threatens Azov Grain Trade

The partial collapse of the Kerch Strait Bridge after Ukrainian strikes could delay the reopening of one of Russia's most important grain export routes by months, with debris falling into the Kerch-Yenikale Canal, the only navigable passage between the Sea of Azov and the Black Sea. The Sea of Azov normally accounts for about 25% of Russian grain exports, but shipping through the strait has been suspended since July amid repeated drone attacks. Russia also claimed strikes on port infrastructure at Izmail and a general cargo ship bound for Pivdennyi, while Ukraine reported Russian strikes on energy infrastructure near Odesa; neither claim has been independently verified.

乌克兰打击导致刻赤海峡大桥一段公路桥面坍塌，碎片落入连接亚速海与黑海的唯一通航运河刻赤-叶尼卡列运河，可能使俄罗斯重要粮食出口通道的恢复推迟数月。亚速海通常占俄罗斯粮食出口约 25%，但自 7 月以来因无人机袭击不断，该水道航运已暂停。俄方还称打击了多瑙河伊兹梅尔港设施及一艘驶往皮夫登尼的普通货船，乌方则称俄军袭击了敖德萨南部能源设施；相关说法未经独立核实。

05地缘政治与海事安全 · 2026年11月18日

黑海 LPG 船 Gas Husky 事件新进展：保加利亚官员证实遭四次抛射物袭击

Black Sea LPG Carrier Gas Husky: Bulgarian Official Confirms Four Projectile Strikes

This is a follow-up to the Black Sea LPG carrier incident already covered yesterday, not a third new attack. In a new development on 18 November, Varna regional governor Mario Smarkov told Reuters there was "no doubt" the LPG carrier Gas Husky was struck four times, although the kind of drones used was not confirmed by the crew, and two maritime security sources told Reuters the tanker was hit by an unmanned system. The Liberia-flagged Gas Husky, carrying 3,400 tonnes of LPG from Alexandria, Egypt, to Midia, Romania, capsized about 50 nautical miles east of Byala, Bulgaria, on 17 November; all 19 Filipino crew were rescued. It followed the capsizing of the wheat carrier Betul 8 on 16 November; together the two incidents left 31 crew rescued.

本条为昨日已刊黑海 LPG 船事件的跟进，不是第三起新袭击。继 11 月 16 日小麦货船 Betul 8 与 11 月 17 日 LPG 船 Gas Husky 在保加利亚黑海专属经济区 24 小时内相继倾覆后，11 月 18 日出现官方口径新进展：瓦尔纳州州长 Mario Smarkov 向路透社表示，Gas Husky 遭袭击的次数“毫无疑问是四次”，但船员未确认无人机种类；另有两名海事安全消息人士向路透社表示该船是被无人系统击中。Gas Husky 为利比里亚旗、载 3,400 吨 LPG，从埃及亚历山大港驶往罗马尼亚米迪亚港，19 名菲律宾船员全部获救。

06地缘政治与海事安全 · 2026年11月18日

欧盟设立专门制裁办公室，任命 Lars Danielsson 为新任制裁事务特使

EU Creates Dedicated Sanctions Office, Names Lars Danielsson as Sanctions Envoy

The European Commission formally created a dedicated EU Sanctions Office on 18 November and named Swedish diplomat Lars Danielsson as its next International Special Envoy for the Implementation of EU Sanctions, taking over from David O'Sullivan on 6 February 2027. The office, launching on 16 January 2027 within the Commission's Secretariat-General under Financial Services Commissioner Maria Luís Albuquerque, will centralise sanctions work across policy design, implementation, enforcement and anti-circumvention, covering regimes on Russia, Belarus, Iran, North Korea and Syria. The EU has adopted 21 sanctions packages against Russia since February 2022, with a 22nd possible as early as December. The move follows a European Court of Auditors report on 10 November finding EU trade sanctions against Russia fall well short of their potential.

欧盟委员会 11 月 18 日正式设立专门的欧盟制裁办公室，并宣布瑞典外交官 Lars Danielsson 将于 2027 年 2 月 6 日起担任国际制裁实施特使，接替现任特使 David O'Sullivan。新办公室将于 2027 年 1 月 16 日启动，设于委员会秘书处，由金融服务委员 Maria Luís Albuquerque 负责政治监督，整合制裁政策设计、实施、执法与反规避全流程工作，覆盖对俄、白俄罗斯、伊朗、朝鲜、叙利亚等全部制裁机制。欧盟迄今已对俄出台 21 轮制裁，第 22 轮最早可能于 12 月通过；此举回应了欧洲审计院 11 月 10 日关于欧盟对俄贸易制裁远未发挥潜力的报告。

07地缘政治与海事安全 · 2026年11月18日

中方撤销对 NewNew Polar Bear 船长的刑事指控，船长认两项轻微疏忽罪并被驱逐

China Drops Criminal Charges Against Captain in Baltic Anchor Dragging Case

Chinese prosecutors told a Hong Kong court on 18 November they are not pursuing criminal charges against Captain Wan Wenguo of the containership NewNew Polar Bear, saying they were unable to locate key witnesses for a criminal trial due to start next month. Wan, detained in Hong Kong since 2024, pleaded guilty to two minor negligence charges — operating without proper anchors and failing to provide daily updates to the shipping company — and was fined about US$500, while the shipping company was fined about US$200; he was immediately deported to the mainland. In October 2023 the vessel dragged its anchor for more than 50 miles across the Baltic seabed, damaging the Balticconnector gas pipeline and telecom cables between Estonia and Finland, with damage reported at more than US$50 million. Nordic states have since increased Baltic patrols and monitoring.

中国检方 11 月 18 日在香港法院表示，不再追究 NewNew Polar Bear 号集装箱船船长 Wan Wenguo 的刑事指控，原因是无法找到刑事案件的关键证人；该案原定下月开庭审理。Wan 自 2024 年起被羁押在香港，他承认两项与船舶操作有关的轻微疏忽罪（无合规锚具情况下航行、未向船公司提供每日报告），船公司被处以约 200 美元罚款，船长被判罚款约 500 美元（须在 2027 年 6 月 30 日前缴纳），并被立即驱逐回内地。该船 2023 年 10 月在波罗的海拖锚航行 50 多海里，损坏了爱沙尼亚与芬兰之间的 Balticconnector 天然气管道和电信电缆，损失据报超过 5,000 万美元。

SBM Offshore 与 Saipem 推进圭亚那重大合同

SBM Offshore and Saipem Move Ahead with Major Guyana Contracts

SBM Offshore and Saipem have secured major contracts for ExxonMobil's $12.5bn Longtail gas and condensate development offshore Guyana. SBM will construct and install an FPSO based on its Fast4Ward design, capable of processing 1.2bn standard cu ft of gas and producing 250,000 barrels of condensate per day with about 2m barrels of storage, which it expects to operate for an initial 10 years — its sixth FPSO contract from ExxonMobil in Guyana. Saipem received authorisation to proceed with full execution of its subsea EPCI contract, valued at $1bn–$1.5bn over four years. ExxonMobil sanctioned Longtail on November 12; first production is expected in 2030.

SBM Offshore 与 Saipem 拿下埃克森美孚 125 亿美元圭亚那 Longtail 天然气与凝析油开发项目的重大合同。SBM 将建造并安装一艘 FPSO，基于 Fast4Ward 设计，可日处理 12 亿标准立方英尺天然气、日产 25 万桶凝析油，储油约 200 万桶，初期运营 10 年，这是其在圭亚那的第六艘 FPSO。Saipem 则获准全面执行价值 10–15 亿美元的海底 EPCI 合同，工期四年。Longtail 已于 11 月 12 日获批，是 Stabroek 区块第八个开发项目，预计 2030 年首产。

09能源、油气与 LNG · 2026年11月18日

Adura 北海 Jackdaw 天然气项目投产

Adura Brings North Sea Gas Project Onstream After Years of Delays

UK offshore producer Adura has started production at its £2.1bn ($2.8bn) Jackdaw gas development in the North Sea, less than a month after receiving fresh regulatory approval. Gas flows from the Jackdaw platform through the Shearwater hub to the St Fergus terminal in Aberdeenshire; at peak production it could supply enough gas to heat the equivalent of 1.4m UK homes, about 6% of domestic gas production. The field was originally approved in 2022, but a court overturned that consent in January 2025 after ruling its environmental assessment failed to consider emissions from burning the gas; renewed approval followed on October 21. Jackdaw is expected to produce for up to 11 years and contribute about $3.8bn to the UK economy.

英国海上生产商 Adura 的 21 亿英镑（28 亿美元）北海 Jackdaw 天然气开发项目已投产，距获得新的监管批准不到一个月。天然气从 Jackdaw 平台经 Shearwater 中枢输送至阿伯丁郡 St Fergus 终端，达产后可为相当于 140 万户英国家庭供暖，约占英国国内天然气产量的 6%。该项目 2022 年首获批准，后因环评未考虑燃烧排放被法院于 2025 年 1 月推翻，10 月 21 日获重新批准；预计生产长达 11 年，为英国经济贡献约 38 亿美元。

Neo Next+ 以 9.6 亿美元收购 EnQuest 北海业务

Neo Next+ Snaps Up EnQuest's North Sea Business in $960m Deal

EnQuest has agreed to sell its UK upstream oil and gas business to NEO NEXT+ for up to $960 million, comprising $840 million in upfront cash at closing plus up to $120 million in contingent payments tied to future oil prices and potential changes to the UK Energy Profits Levy. The deal covers the operated Magnus, Kraken and Greater Kittiwake Area fields, the non-operated Golden Eagle field, the undeveloped Bressay field and Bentley discovery, plus midstream interests including the Sullom Voe Terminal and about $2.125 billion in UK decommissioning and other liabilities. EnQuest will pivot to Southeast Asia, with completion expected in the first quarter of 2027.

Oil Falls as U.S. Stockpiles Rise More Than Expected; Brent–WTI Spread Widens

U.S. crude inventories rose by 3.4 million barrels to 417.8 million barrels in the week ended 13 November, the EIA said, far above the 58,000-barrel build expected in a Reuters poll, while gasoline stocks rose 5.2 million barrels and distillates 1.6 million barrels, reinforcing surplus expectations and pushing oil lower on 18 November. The Brent–WTI spread widened to its widest in about two weeks, with WTI falling more steeply as arbitrage to Asia and Northwest Europe shut and U.S. Gulf Coast stocks rose. Continued U.S.–Iran conflict and Hormuz shipping risks limited the decline; both benchmarks were on track for falls of about 20% in November.

Dry Bulk FFA Trading Heads for Another Record Year

Dry bulk forward freight agreement (FFA) trading is heading for another record year as geopolitical upheaval drives greater demand for freight hedging. New analysis from Ursa Shipbrokers, using Baltic Exchange data, shows 3.16m lots changed hands between January and October, up 12% year-on-year and just short of the 3.33m lots traded in all of 2025; the market has more than doubled since 2020, when turnover was 1.56m lots. Supramax contracts grew fastest, up 28.1% to 578,772 lots, while capesize volumes rose 11.5% to 1.34m lots and panamax activity increased 6.3% to 1.21m lots. March saw 435,102 lots traded, the highest monthly figure since records began in 2007.

干散货远期运费协议（FFA）交易量有望再创纪录，地缘动荡推动更多运费对冲需求。Ursa Shipbrokers 援引波罗的海交易所数据称，1–10 月共成交 316 万手，同比增长 12%，已接近 2025 年全年 333 万手的总量；市场规模较 2020 年的 156 万手翻了一倍多。其中超灵便型增长最快（+28.1% 至 578,772 手），海岬型 134 万手（+11.5%），巴拿马型 121 万手（+6.3%）；3 月单月成交 435,102 手，为 2007 年有记录以来最高。

Guinea Leaps to Third-Largest Iron Ore Exporter, Boosting Capesize Tonne-Mile Demand

Guinea became the world's third-largest iron ore exporter in October 2026, with exports surpassing 5 million tonnes for the first time and accounting for 3% of global iron ore volumes, BIMCO shipping analysis manager Filipe Gouveia said. More than 22 million tonnes have been shipped so far in 2026, already above initial industry projections of around 20 million tonnes for the full year. The Simandou project, which began mining in December 2025, is expected to reach about 120 million tonnes a year at full capacity. Guinean ore travels 88% longer distances than the average iron ore shipment and accounted for 6% of global iron ore tonne-mile demand in October; tonne-mile demand could rise 13% versus 2025 if Guinean exports reach 120 million tonnes.

BIMCO 航运分析经理 Filipe Gouveia 表示，2026 年 10 月几内亚铁矿石出口首次突破 500 万吨，占全球铁矿石出口量的 3%，成为全球第三大铁矿石出口国；2026 年至今已出口逾 2,200 万吨，已超过业界全年约 2,000 万吨的初步预测。西芒杜项目 2025 年 12 月投产，满产后年产能约 1.2 亿吨，目前出口量已达计划月产能的一半左右。几内亚铁矿石几乎全部运往中国，其平均运距比全球铁矿石平均运距长 88%，10 月占全球铁矿石吨海里需求的 6%；若几内亚出口达到 1.2 亿吨而其他出口国维持现有规模，全球铁矿石吨海里需求较 2025 年可上升 13%。

Nine Shipping Associations Urge Governments to Agree a Workable Net-Zero Framework at MEPC 85

Nine of the world's leading shipping associations have joined forces to push governments towards a global emissions deal, warning that a patchwork of regional regulations risks leaving shipowners paying multiple times for the same carbon emissions. BIMCO, the International Chamber of Shipping (ICS), Intercargo, Intertanko, the World Shipping Council, Cruise Lines International Association (CLIA), Interferry, the International Bunker Industry Association (IBIA) and the International Parcel Tankers Association (IPTA) called for a single global framework applying equally to all vessels. The intervention comes after the IMO failed to secure agreement on its proposed Net-Zero Framework in October 2025, forcing adoption to be postponed by a year; governments resume negotiations at the IMO greenhouse gas working group from November 23 to 27, followed by MEPC 85 from November 30 to December 3, with Friday 4 December set aside for debate and agreement on the Net-Zero Framework.

全球九大航运协会联合发声，呼吁各国政府达成全球排放协议，警告各地区法规各自为政可能让船东为同一吨碳排放多次付费。参与的组织包括 BIMCO、国际航运公会（ICS）、Intercargo、Intertanko、世界航运理事会、国际邮轮协会（CLIA）、Interferry、国际燃油工业协会（IBIA）和国际油轮协会（IPTA）。各方要求建立适用于所有船舶的单一全球框架，奖励可核实的减排，并保持燃料与技术中立。背景是 IMO 净零框架谈判 2025 年 10 月未能达成协议、推迟一年，政府间谈判将于 11 月 23–27 日工作组会议及 11 月 30 日–12 月 3 日 MEPC 85 恢复，12 月 4 日专门讨论并议定净零框架。

UK Sets Out 2030 Marine Fuel Crackdown

Britain has laid out plans for a new shipping fuel regulation that could initially cover around 5,000 vessels calling at its ports, including ships on international routes. The Department for Transport opened a consultation on a proposed greenhouse gas intensity standard, which the government expects to introduce from 2030. The regime would initially apply to ships of 5,000 gt and above, irrespective of flag, requiring operators to progressively reduce the lifecycle emissions intensity of the fuels and energy they use. Under the government's preferred approach, the rules would cover all energy consumed on domestic voyages, half the energy used on voyages between British and foreign ports, and emissions generated while ships are alongside in the UK. Government modelling suggests 4,913 vessels of at least 5,000 gt called at UK ports in 2019; the consultation closes on February 22, 2027.

Independent Probe Finds No Evidence of $250m X-Press Pearl Bribe

An independent investigation by Sigma7 Business Intelligence, commissioned by London P&I Club on behalf of X-Press Pearl owner X-Press Feeders, found no evidence substantiating the allegation that the club or the owners paid a $250 million bribe to influence Sri Lankan authorities over compensation for the sinking of the X-Press Pearl. The allegation stemmed from an anonymous WhatsApp message whose original text, phone number and sender have never been disclosed; purported account details for a NatWest bank account in the UK were inconsistent, and the funds were said to have moved to an unverifiable account in the Bahamas. Former head of the Metropolitan Police's Counter Terrorism Command Richard Walton endorsed the central conclusion that there is "no credible evidence whatsoever". The 2,756-TEU X-Press Pearl caught fire off Colombo in May 2021 and sank on 2 June 2021; the owner was fined $1 billion for causing "catastrophic" pollution.

受伦敦保赔协会（London P&I Club）委托、代表 X-Press Pearl 船东 X-Press Feeders 进行的 Sigma7 独立调查认为，没有证据证明伦敦保赔协会或船东曾支付 2.5 亿美元贿赂，以影响斯里兰卡政府就 X-Press Pearl 沉船事故索赔的行动。调查指出，指控源于一则匿名 WhatsApp 消息，原始消息、电话号码与发件人从未公开；所谓贿款汇入英国 NatWest 银行账户的说法存在账户信息不一致，资金去向又被说成转入巴哈马一个无法核实的账户。曾任伦敦警察厅反恐指挥部负责人的 Richard Walton 审阅调查方法后表示，完全认同“没有任何可信证据”的核心结论。X-Press Pearl 于 2021 年 5 月在科伦坡外海起火、6 月 2 日沉没，船东曾因造成“灾难性”污染被处以 10 亿美元罚款。

香港海事人才“缺失的中层”

The Missing Middle in Hong Kong's Maritime Workforce

Hong Kong wants to expand its role in global shipping, but its maritime ambitions face a stubborn recruitment problem: finding graduates is one thing, while attracting and retaining experienced professionals 10 or 15 years into their careers is quite another. The Vocational Training Council's latest maritime manpower survey counts 25,993 employees in 2024, including 13,746 in shore-based jobs, with just 384 vacancies but a 9.1% turnover rate among shore-based staff. Earlier VTC research identified a hollowed-out middle in high-value maritime services, with senior staff nearing retirement and junior employees still gaining experience, and a shortage of people with seagoing qualifications for roles such as port captain, technical superintendent and ship surveyor. Employers in Singapore, mainland China and industries far beyond shipping are competing for the same individuals.

香港希望扩大在全球航运中的角色，但海事人才招聘存在顽固问题：难的不只是吸引毕业生，更是吸引并留住有 10–15 年经验的中层专业人才。职训局最新海事人力调查显示 2024 年从业人员 25,993 人，其中岸上职位 13,746 人，空缺仅 384 个，但岸上员工流失率达 9.1%；早期研究已发现高增值海事服务存在“中层空心化”，高级员工临近退休、初级员工经验尚浅，港口船长、技术总监和验船师等需要航海资历的岗位尤其缺人。新加坡、中国内地及航运以外行业都在争夺同一批人。

超过 5 万名菲律宾海员的个人信息疑似在一个地下网络犯罪论坛上出现的数据泄露中被曝光，真实性尚未核实。2026 年《全球海员健康与权利蓝皮书》显示，在受访的 4,445 名海员中，35.1% 称上次航行中工时与休息时间规定被违反，31% 未获得补偿性休息。另据英国议会听证会，6 月期间伊朗卫星干扰每天影响霍尔木兹海峡约 970 艘船，英国海事部门正敦促船员重练雷达定位、推算船位和天文导航。
